mismatch_resolution: Normalize header coordinates using cut offsets and canonicalize sequence IDs to first FASTA defline token.
notes: Do not compare radigest against full read/PCR/allele-dropout simulation workflows.

notes: Raw output must be normalized using enzyme cut offsets; degenerate motif support and terminal-fragment behavior require separate verification.
